sentences.en: All afternoon a violent storm scoured the little town's streets.
sentences.zh: 整个下午，一场猛烈的暴风雨冲刷着小镇的街道。

sentences.en: Sami scoured the Internet to find more information about that.
sentences.zh: 萨米在网上四处搜寻以找到更多关于那方面的信息。

sentences.en: How our cat loves to scour someone else's dishes!
sentences.zh: 我们的猫多么喜欢去舔洗别人的碗碟啊！

senses.zh: 擦，冲刷；洗涤剂；（畜类等的）腹泻
